editor.writeIntro: Write a new letter, no more than 500 words.
editor.title: Title

closed.title: The newtork is closed
closed.subtitle: Writing is paused between 10pm and 7am in your timezone.

perDay.title: 17 per day
perDay.body: A maximum of 17 actions a day, as the number of syllables in a Haiku.

noScroll.title: No scroll
noScroll.body: Reading happens 1 text at a time, followed by the answers.

peerReviewed.title: Peer reviewed
peerReviewed.body: Moderation happens a priori, by the peers.

sourced.title: Sourced
sourced.body: Texts are presented and annotated with context & references.

singleFeatured.title: Single-featured
singleFeatured.body: No job board, training, quiz, whatever… Just a place to discuss with peers.

noAds.title: No advertising
noAds.body: Just a community driven, open source network.

nig.title: NIG compliant
nig.body: Fully embraces the NIG framework for Numérique d'Intérêt Général.

who.title: Who?
who.detail: Where am I speaking from? What are my beliefs? What are my views?

what.title: What?
what.detail: What is it about? What is the topic? In what tense?
